description: This file contains unit tests for the SharedStorage and related components in a C++ project, utilizing Google Test and Google Mock frameworks. It tests various functionalities such as setting and getting shared storage values, deleting keys/namespaces, retrieving keys/namespaces, and storage size limits, across different scopes (device, account). It also includes mock classes for notification handling and mock gRPC server interactions.
